facts.fact: GovStack says a conversational AI chatbot is being designed for Kenya's eCitizen platform, with the Kenya Film Commission as pilot institution and service design just started, under the EU-co-financed IDGC programme.

KEN.note: Capacity development for civil servants is listed as a donor programme activity with no course held or government programme stated.

facts.fact: GovStack cites Kenya's Digital Master Plan (2022-2032) as setting the aim of digitalising 80% of government services.
GovStack names the Digital Master Plan's period as 2022-2032.

GovStack says Kenya already has an eGovernment platform, eCitizen, offering government services whose application procedures an AI chatbot is meant to shorten; no count of services is given and it notes uncoordinated siloed automation in ministries.
